item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:45 HKT 12/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front is expected to move across the coast of Guangdong between Sunday night and Monday morning. Temperatures will fall appreciably and there will be a few rain patches over the region. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon associated with the cold front, the weather will improve with cool mornings over southern China early next week. A broad band of clouds will bring rainy weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
